nodes.label: A brief is not a contract
nodes.rationale: A brand email carrying a PDF and talking about a contract or agreement should only be treated as a contract if explicitly named or written as one; otherwise, it is a brief.

nodes.label: Brief file lands on card
nodes.rationale: Brand brief files (PDF, Word, slides) must be attached to the video card and the script writer notified.

nodes.label: Content words reach script writer
nodes.rationale: Creative content notes should not be dropped even if they contain money-related words (budget, price, cost).

nodes.label: One video card per reel
nodes.rationale: Deals covering multiple reels require a separate card per reel to avoid mixing briefs.
